```yaml
name: Release Studio

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: true

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cache/go-build
            ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('**/go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run gofmt check
        run: |
          make format
          git diff --exit-code

      - name: Check command docs
        run: make check-command-docs

      - name: Lint
        run: make lint

      - name: Run tests
        env:
          ASC_BYPASS_KEYCHAIN: 1
        run: make test
```
